subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group warn/leave config, and which denied-group reasons should be allowed to trigger a Telegram leaveChat side effect?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing config plus a security-sensitive Telegram side effect, so maintainers need to choose the supported product/security contract before automation can treat the branch as a straightforward bug fix.

options.title: Revise this PR around a narrow contract
options.body: Keep the feature direction but require true-unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, thread-helper use, docs/metadata alignment, tests, and redacted live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader group security design
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the behavior into the broader group pairing or cross-channel unauthorized-group work already tracked by related issues.

options.title: Keep deny-only Telegram behavior
options.body: Decline warn/leave config for now and keep current fail-closed drop/static-denial behavior as the supported Telegram posture.

recommendation.title: Revise this PR around a narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction but require true-unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, thread-helper use, docs/metadata alignment, tests, and redacted live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice affects Telegram config, authorization, native commands, and security side effects, and steipete has the strongest recent routing signal for those surfaces.
